LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Export_Tip: Save the cinematic to an XML file and register its definition.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Import_Tip: Read an XML file or paste cinematic XML, then apply it to the editor.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_InvalidFile: Check the file path and .xml extension. Files being loaded must exist and be no larger than 2 MiB.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_InvalidName: Use a valid XML name with a mod prefix and underscore, such as CQF_Intro.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_InvalidXml: XML must contain one valid cinematic definition.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Load_Tip: Choose a loaded cinematic definition to edit.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_New_Tip: Create a blank cinematic, replacing the current editor contents.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_NoDefinitions: No cinematic definitions are available to load.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_NoGame: Enter a game and open a map first.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Preview_Tip: Preview visuals and sound only. Pawn commands, dialog, quest actions, external waits and signals are skipped. Preview playback is not saved.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_ReorderSameGroup: Drag steps within the same group to reorder them.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Run_Tip: Play the full cinematic, including pawn commands, dialog, quest actions and outcome signals.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_SelectTarget: Enter a target key, then select an object or enter a valid map cell.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Stop_Tip: Cancel the queued or playing cinematic. Full playback sends its configured cancellation signal.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_UnsupportedField: This field cannot be edited here
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_MapPickDestination: Click the destination on the map.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_MapPickFacing: Click a position for the pawn to face.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_MapRequired: Enter a game and open a map first.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_ProjectLoadFailed: Could not open the cinematic. Check its definition and editing files.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestFailed: Cinematic test failed: {0}. Restoring the original editing state.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestRunning: A full test is running in a copy. The original editing state will be restored when it ends.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RecordCamera_Tip: Record the current camera position and zoom as a camera step.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RecordMove_Tip: Select a pawn, then click its destination to record a step. Pawns move only during a full test in a copy.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RecordFacing_Tip: Select a pawn, then click a position to record the direction it should face.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_PreviewSelection_Tip: Preview the selected step's visuals and sound only. Pawn commands and quest actions are not executed.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_PreviewAll_Tip: Preview the whole cinematic's visuals and sound only. Pawn commands and quest actions are not executed.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestCopy_Tip: Save a temporary checkpoint, run the full cinematic in a copy, then restore the original editing state.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_SaveProject_Tip: Save cinematic steps, map target bindings and bilingual subtitles automatically.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_OpenProject_Tip: Open a saved cinematic or create a new one.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestBusy: A cinematic test is already running. Return to editing before starting another.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestSaveBlocked: Saving is unavailable during a full test. Return to editing to save normally.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestCheckpointFailed: Could not create the test checkpoint. The test has not started. Save path: {0}
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestRecoveryFailed: Could not restore the editing state automatically. The checkpoint has been kept; load it manually to restore the world before the test: {0}
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_TestInterrupted: The previous cinematic test did not end normally. The checkpoint has been kept; load it manually to restore the world before the test: {0}
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_InvalidBinding: The selected object or cell is no longer valid. Select it again on the current map.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_BindingWorldMismatch: The recorded cinematic targets belong to another world. Bind targets in the current world again.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_BindingMapMissing: The recorded map no longer exists, so its targets cannot be restored.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_BindingThingMissing: A recorded pawn or object no longer exists, so its target cannot be restored.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_BindingQuestMissing: The linked quest no longer exists. Select another quest or remove the link.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_DuplicateSubtitle: A subtitle record is duplicated or invalid. Set that subtitle again.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_SubtitleBothRequired: Enter both the Chinese and English subtitle text before saving.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_InvalidSubtitleFile: The subtitle resource file is invalid or contains duplicate text keys. Saving was stopped.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_InvalidScene: The editing record does not match the cinematic definition and cannot be opened.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_InvalidProject: The cinematic is incomplete or invalid. Check its steps and settings.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_ProjectSaveFailed: Could not save the cinematic. Restoration of the original files was attempted. Check the error log.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Review_InvalidCsv: The text review CSV has invalid columns or text keys. Saving was stopped to preserve its review content.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_ReplaceDraftConfirm: Replace the current cinematic? Unsaved changes will be replaced.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleNoActors: Add a pawn step to configure role bindings.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_ActorBindings_Tip: Set each pawn role's name, playback source and rehearsal pawn. Event and database sources are resolved again during formal playback.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleName_Tip: Give the role a recognizable name. You can change it at any time.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleSource_Tip: Choose where formal playback gets this role: the recorded pawn, the triggering event or a database. Event and database sources do not fall back to the rehearsal pawn.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_SourceKey_Tip: Enter the target name in the selected source. For a database, use an existing record name. Formal playback uses this name to find the role.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RehearsalPawn_Tip: The selected pawn is used for editing and tests in a copy. For a recorded-pawn source, choosing another pawn also updates the playback binding. Event and database roles are still resolved at runtime.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_ChooseRehearsalPawn_Tip: Choose a pawn on the map for rehearsal. Event and database roles are still supplied at runtime during formal playback.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Source_Recorded_Tip: Formal playback uses the currently recorded pawn. Choosing another pawn updates the binding.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Source_Context_Tip: Formal playback uses the named target passed in by the triggering event. The binding name must match the event target's name.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Source_QuestDatabase_Tip: Formal playback finds exactly one pawn by the binding name in the linked quest's database.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Source_TemporaryDatabase_T: Formal playback finds exactly one pawn by the binding name in the temporary database. Prepare that record before triggering the cinematic.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_Source_GlobalDatabase_Tip: Formal playback finds exactly one pawn by the binding name in the global database.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleKeyRequired: The binding record for role '{0}' is incomplete. Create this role binding again.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleSourceKeyRequired: Enter a binding name for role '{0}'.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleMissing: Role '{0}' was not found in the selected source. Check its source and binding record.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleNotPawn: The target for role '{0}' is not a valid pawn. Check its binding record.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleAmbiguous: Role '{0}' matches multiple targets. Make sure the selected source identifies exactly one pawn.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleNoQuest: Role '{0}' uses the quest database, but this playback has no linked quest.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleTestPawnMissing: Role '{0}' has no valid rehearsal pawn. Choose a pawn on the map first.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleDuplicate: The binding record for role '{0}' is duplicated. Remove the duplicate and bind the role again.
LanguageData.CQF_Cinematic_RoleSourceInvalid: Role '{0}' has an invalid source setting. Select its source again.
